email.subject: POAP KINGS is recruiting — war-focused clan with 14k players and a culture worth staying for
email.body:
POAP KINGS is a competitive Clash Royale clan built around Clan Wars, real recognition, and long-term memory.

We have three members sitting at 14,000 trophies, over 5,300 donations this week, and a roster that shows up when battle days matter. Our top war contributors earn a free Pass Royale at season end — not as a gimmick, but as a genuine clan tradition.

What makes us different: we issue POAPs for seasons and milestones, giving members a collectible record of their time in the clan. We also run Elixir, an AI system that tracks war performance, highlights contributors, and helps the clan build continuity most clans never develop.

We want players who care about winning Clan Wars and being part of something with structure and identity. Real life comes first — we just ask that you show up when you can.

Minimum 5,000 trophies. Come see what we're building at https://poapkings.com

reddit.title: POAP KINGS (#J2RGCRVG) — War-focused clan recruiting | [5000] trophies required
reddit.body:
**POAP KINGS** is looking for active players who take Clan Wars seriously and want to be part of a clan with real identity.

**Clan snapshot:**
- Tag: #J2RGCRVG
- Members: 40
- Required trophies: 5,000
- Three members at 14,000 trophies (OllieTurtle, Vijay, Aaqib Javed)
- 5,300+ weekly donations
- War season leaders: Shafith Nihal (1,700 fame), Chanco (1,500 fame)

**Who we are:**

We're a four-month-old clan built by players who wanted something more structured than the average public clan. Founders Raquaza and King Levy have been playing Clash together for years. King Thing built the systems that keep the clan running — including Elixir, an in-clan AI that tracks war performance and recognizes real contribution.

We issue POAPs — collectible on-chain records tied to seasons and milestones. It's an unusual tradition and one we're proud of. Our top war contributor each season earns a free Pass Royale. Last season, a player who used every war deck on every battle day won it for perfect contribution.

**What we're looking for:**
- 5,000+ trophies
- Shows up on battle days and uses war decks
- Wants to be part of a clan that remembers what you do

Real life always comes first. We don't guilt-trip. We just want players who care when they're playing.

Learn more and apply at **https://poapkings.com**
